description: Contradiction finder (grounded) — Find statements that contradict each other - between two texts (a= and b=, e.g. a contract vs. an invoice, docs vs. a policy, two answers from different agents) or inside one document (a= only). Each finding has exact quotes from both sides, type (numeric, date, factual, logical, policy, definition), severity and an explanation. Findings are kept only if both quotes are found in your text (offline check) and, for numeric conflicts, the numbers really differ; dropped ones are listed under unverified. Verdict CONSISTENT / MINOR_ISSUES / CONTRADICTIONS_FOUND. Up to 16,000 chars total. Price: $0.01 USDC (Base, via x402).

a.description: e.g. The Pro plan costs $20 per month and includes 5 users. Refunds are available within 30 days.

b.description: e.g. Pro pricing: $25/month for up to 5 users. All sales are final and no refunds are given.

name: ai_contradictions
